name: WordWorld third fresh 50-command evaluation — 2026-10-15
method: 50 newly hand-authored commands and expected actions frozen before prediction after reference/coordination fixes. Author saw implementation and prior results; not independently human-labeled or randomly sampled. No tuning on round-three results.
scope: 40 core commands and 10 preassigned broader grammar probes. All commands start with empty request-local reference context. Singular it resolves the latest live singular introduction; them resolves the latest coordinated creation collection. Explicit new creation verbs reset collection focus. Existing named landmarks assumed; geometry and cross-request context are not scored.
evaluation_kind: retest after parser development; not unseen-command accuracy

metric_definitions.exact_match: Complete ordered action dictionaries match, including all emitted fields; per command over all 50.
metric_definitions.intent: Ordered action-name sequence matches; per command over all 50. Does not validate entity or setting value.
metric_definitions.entity_count_color: Ordered (action, type, count, color) tuples for all typed actions match, per command over all 50. Pure setting/no-op cases contribute empty typed-action lists.
metric_definitions.spatial: Ordered (type, relation, target, targets) tuples for all typed actions match, on gold-spatial commands only. Extra subjects are penalized.
metric_definitions.settings: Ordered (key, value) tuples for setting actions match, on gold-setting commands only.

cases.text: Add two bridges spanning the stream.
Place a road crossing the creek.
Draw a bridge spanning the river and three red cottages.
Build a bridge spanning the creek; plant four trees behind it.
Don’t build bridges crossing the stream; add a tower.
warnings: Skipped a negated instruction; no objects were changed for that clause.

cases.text: Create a castle, then put a tree to the left of it.
Build three red cottages; remove two of them.
Plant four flowers; remove one of them; remove them.
Make a tower and a cottage; place a rock between them.
Add two lakes; put a bridge between them.
Create a road; make it night; plant two trees near it.
Add a rock; remove it; remove it again.
cases.label_note: The second removal has no live antecedent and must abstain, preserving unrelated scene rocks.
warnings: 'it' has no object antecedent in this command.

cases.text: Build a house, a tower, and a castle; remove them.
Create six trees; erase twenty of them.
cases.label_note: Removal is bounded by the six introduced trees, not by unrelated existing trees; a notice is expected.
warnings: Reference contains only 6 objects; removal was limited to that collection.

cases.text: Add two rocks; never remove them.
warnings: Skipped a negated instruction; no objects were changed for that clause.

cases.text: Build a cottage and a tower; delete one of them.
cases.label_note: A partial selection from a mixed collection is ambiguous; removal abstains with a notice.
warnings: A partial removal from a mixed collection needs an explicit object type.

cases.text: Plant three trees; remove it.
cases.label_note: Singular it cannot select one unspecified member of a plural group.
warnings: 'it' needs one unambiguous object, not a plural group.

cases.text: Remove them; add a lake.
cases.label_note: Every command starts with an empty reference context.
warnings: 'them' has no object antecedent in this command.

cases.text: Build a house; reset; put a flower near it.
cases.label_note: Reset invalidates the house antecedent; the final spatial instruction abstains.
warnings: 'it' has no object antecedent in this command.
A spatial instruction needs named landmarks; use 'between two houses' or 'between the house and the lake'.

cases.text: Create one white and one orange house; add a flower between them.
Add two green and four purple trees.
Build a yellow and a pink cottage.
Place three white, two blue, and one purple flower.
Plant a pair of yellow and three pink flowers.
Build two red and not three blue cottages.
warnings: Skipped a negated or zero-count house group.

cases.text: Near the tower, plant one pink and one white flower.
Add two blue and three red houses behind the lake.
Create one green and one yellow tree; remove them.
Put one purple and one pink flower beside the castle, then remove it.
cases.label_note: It selects the last singular subject group, the pink flower.

cases.text: Build two red houses and one blue house; put a rock behind it.
cases.label_note: It refers specifically to the last singular introduction, the blue house.

cases.text: Keep the lake; add fourteen white flowers.
warnings: Preserved referenced objects; no creation or removal was applied for that clause.

cases.text: Don’t create any castles; build a bridge spanning the stream.
warnings: Skipped a negated instruction; no objects were changed for that clause.

cases.text: South of the tower, place a dozen pink flowers.
Build one hundred and three blue cottages.
cases.label_note: Apply the existing 16-object action cap to 103 requested objects.

cases.text: Clear everything; add a river; build a bridge spanning it.
Make it rain and then stop raining; create a rock.
Build zero red and one green house.
warnings: Skipped a negated or zero-count house group.

cases.text: Add a tree; make it day; remove it.
Beside the castle, add a pair of orange flowers and a red house.
Build a tower; remove it; add two blue flowers.
Build a cottage with an orange roof.
Place a house whose roof is green.
Build a bridge that crosses the river.
cases.label_note: The finite verb crosses paraphrases across; expected output does not request a second river.
warnings: Unsupported connection between object nouns; that object instruction was skipped instead of creating its landmark.

cases.text: Construct three white homes near the river.
warnings: Skipped a context-only or unsupported instruction; use an explicit add/build/plant verb to create objects.

cases.text: Keep the trees untouched while building a house.
warnings: Preserved referenced objects; no creation or removal was applied for that clause.

cases.text: Make it day without any rain.
Add a house to the east side of the lake.
warnings: Unsupported connection between object nouns; that object instruction was skipped instead of creating its landmark.

cases.text: Plant two trees and put a flower between those trees.
cases.label_note: Those trees names the type explicitly; a correct action match does not establish general demonstrative or color-filtered reference support.

cases.text: Build houses, three of them.
Place two small and three large houses.
cases.label_note: Score distinct coordinated count groups using existing action fields; size rendering is not scored.
